thread:
maria: Heads-up — I'm assembling a tiny Astro + Next hybrid starter that wires LlamaClient for quick eval harnesses. Trying to make edge API routes + static front-end so people can spin up an eval in <5 minutes. Ran into some weird auth/retry behavior, posting logs below.
aj: What does the error look like? 401 or timeouts?
maria: 401s intermittently, but then retries succeed — which means some requests are being processed twice by our service. Example log: ```edge-api | POST /api/generate  -> 401 Unauthorized
edge-api | retrying request (1) -> 200 OK
llama | generated 2 tokens
edge-api | processed request id=abcd1234
edge-api | processed request id=abcd1234```
devon: That smells like env var mismatch in the starter. I noticed our .env.example uses REDWOOD_KEY but the edge adapter expects REDWOOD_API_KEY. If someone copies the example and runs on edge runtime, the key is undefined in that context and some requests get 401 then the client retries.
maria: Ugh. You're right — thanks. I also saw the browser/edge SDK default retry behavior differs from node SDK (edge has automatic retries on 401 -> which is dodgey). Might be SDK parity issue.
sam: Two quick suggestions: 1) standardize on REDWOOD_API_KEY in .env.example + README quickstart; 2) add idempotency header for server-side routes so retry doesn't double-process. Something like: ```res.setHeader('x-idempotency-key', req.headers['x-request-id'] || uuid())```
maria: Nice, I'll add idempotency and fix the env names. One other gotcha: the example starter boots the edge handler in dev with a simulated fetch wrapper that swallows 401s and retries with a fresh token, so local dev looked fine but prod failed. I'll remove that wrapper.
aj: For the SDK part, file an issue for parity? Edge/browser should match node defaults for retry counts and backoff. It's a common onboarding footgun.
devon: I agree. Also add a short section in the quickstart: "Auth gotchas on Edge runtimes" explaining CORS/credential scoping and env var mapping.
ci-bot: CI failed: tests/starter/e2e.js:42 — flakiness in retry behavior (1 failed, rerun passed). See https://ci.internal/reports/1979991111
maria: Created PR to update starter: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-starters/pull/348 — fixes .env.example, adds idempotency header, removes dev-only retry wrapper, and updates README with an "Edge auth" note.
sam: Awesome. Can you also add a tiny snippet for configuring client retry rules? Quick example: ```js
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY,
  retry: { attempts: 3, retryOn: [429, 502, 503, 504], backoffMs: 300 },
})
```
maria: Will do. Also adding a small eval-harness checklist (seed prompts, idempotency, env var check, minimal telemetry) so customers don't hit this during onboarding.
aj: Thanks — this is a good small DX win.
maria: Marking this thread resolved for now. Will bump if PR introduces regressions. :thumbsup:
